name: Leaf Pile
hook: Rake the biggest leaf pile. Then jump in it.
how: Hold to rake leaves into your arms and let go to drop them on a pile; bag big piles for coins before a gust blows the small ones apart. The trees keep shedding all afternoon, and a pile of 60 or more is begging for a jump.
controls: Hold the mouse to walk and rake (or WASD + hold Space), let go to drop, E bags, Q jumps in, B blower; touch: drag to walk, hold RAKE, BAG and JUMP by a pile
uses: The host's browser keeps every leaf and pile, runs the clock, the falling leaves and the gusts; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone rakes the same yard: your own raking shows at once and lands for everyone a moment later.
Bot neighbors rake leaves to their own piles, bag them, jump in the big ones and buy the leaf blower too, until enough people join.
The most coins each player made in one afternoon.
Make every wave of falling leaves bigger or smaller with no new deploy.
ideas: Add a squirrel that steals leaves from the biggest pile
Make it a beach, raking seaweed into piles
Let players trade coins for a bigger rake
